review.scope: Changed R38 geometry, supports and toolpath checks after repairs
review.verdict: Ready for a first physical fit trial with cleanup and small-support caveats

dispositions.resolution: Tiny tip trimmed and local support added; final slice has no unsupported start.

dispositions.issue: Permanent bead intrusion in rod bore
dispositions.resolution: Local transition relief; final slice has no permanent bore intrusion.

dispositions.issue: Sparse material in OP1 mounting shoulders
dispositions.resolution: Local solid infill; minimum coverage exceeds 95%.
1.9 mm ribs; critical slice coverage passes.

dispositions.issue: Support occupies functional rod and connector spaces
dispositions.resolution: Explicit occupancy reporting, fragment access check and must-clean assembly instruction.

dispositions.issue: New bracket left rail lacked critical-material check
dispositions.resolution: Added exact rail check; minimum coverage exceeds 94%.

dispositions.issue: Cleanup text omitted rear bore exit
dispositions.resolution: Caption names the open rear end and full passage check.

limits: Support-removal grid is a coarse fragment-level check, not physical removability proof.
Outer guard has a slender support column; watch the first trial.
Connector depth and lead bend are estimated from manufacturer photos; physical fit remains unverified.
The exact-centre fit goal is met, but significant weight or width reduction is not.

gui_final_reopen_reslice.difference: GUI re-slice relocated wipe tower and omitted approved gentle layer commands; it is not a cleared print file.
